prompt: We walked (much / far) to the station than to the park.
explanation_ru: Сравнительную степень наречия far усиливаем словом much (а не very). В значении расстояния подходят оба варианта: farther и further.

prompt: This bike shop isn't (any / cheap) than the one near my flat.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении перед сравнительной степенью используют any: not any cheaper означает «ничуть не дешевле».

prompt: Are the new bus signs (any / clear) than the old ones?
explanation_ru: В вопросах перед сравнительной степенью используют усилитель any («хоть сколько-нибудь понятнее»).

prompt: My new phone battery lasts (much / long) than my old one did.
explanation_ru: Глагол lasts требует наречия long в сравнительной степени longer, а для усиления ставим much.

prompt: Callum's sister is (two years / old) than him, though she looks younger.
explanation_ru: Точную разницу в возрасте ставят прямо перед сравнительной степенью прилагательного: two years older.

prompt: We spent (a lot / little / money) at the station café, though the food tasted (even / good) than in the centre.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным money используется less, усиленное a lot; для усиления неправильной формы better подходит even.

prompt: The new washing machine fills far (fast) than our old one, and it spins (slightly / quietly) at night.
explanation_ru: После усилителей far и slightly нужна сравнительная степень наречий: короткое fast даёт faster, а quietly — more quietly.

prompt: Check your cabin bag before flying because it must be (no / heavy) than ten kilos at the gate.
explanation_ru: Конструкция no + сравнительная степень выражает верхний предел («не тяжелее десяти килограммов, включая ровно десять»).

prompt: Greenwood Camp is by far (quiet) site in the valley, even though it is (second / close) to the road.
explanation_ru: После by far при выборе из многих мест ставится превосходная степень с the; порядковое числительное the second- образует конструкцию «второй по близости».

prompt: During the staff meeting, Priya spoke (a bit / sharply) than she meant to, yet the director's reply sounded (still / cold) when everyone asked about weekend shifts.
explanation_ru: Наречие sharply образует сравнительную степень через more с модификатором a bit; still перед colder усиливает контраст («ещё холоднее»).

prompt: This year's sleep survey may have fewer replies, yet its findings are (no / little / useful) than the first study and highlight (easily / big) problem for teenagers.
explanation_ru: No less useful означает «ничуть не менее полезны»; усилитель easily ставится перед превосходной степенью с артиклем the.

prompt: Could the morning commute take (even / long) than we feared if (a lot / few / train) run while the station roof is repaired?
explanation_ru: Even усиливает сравнительную степень longer, а с исчисляемым существительным trains используется fewer с модификатором a lot.

prompt: Marek, the rain is stopping at last. Waiting half an hour is (a bit / good) than cancelling our picnic. The grass is still wet, so let's sit near the dry path. That spot is by far (sunny) place in the park.
explanation_ru: Для мягкого сравнения двух вариантов берём a bit better, а после by far при выборе лучшего места в парке нужна превосходная степень the sunniest.

prompt: I borrowed Daria's revision notes before our history test. The summary at the front skips several dates, so it didn't help me much. However, her full chapters explain the main events (rather / clearly) than the textbook does. She also includes (slightly / few / detail) about minor kings, which makes the pages easier to scan. Overall, her notebook was (easily / helpful) guide I used before the exam.
explanation_ru: Модификатор rather усиливает сравнительное наречие more clearly, slightly смягчает fewer с исчисляемым details, а easily стоит перед превосходной степенью the most helpful.

prompt: Last autumn, our local sports club cut its budget. The main pool stayed busy, and members there now book lanes much (early) than before. The small gym across town wasn't so lucky, as its staff work (considerably / hard) just to keep the doors open. Even so, the coaching there remains by far (friendly) in the area.
explanation_ru: После much и considerably ставим сравнительные наречия earlier и harder; после by far при сравнении по всему району нужна превосходная степень the friendliest.

prompt: Fiona visited the new photo show at the city gallery. Most guests walked through the first room quietly and seemed only mildly curious. The second hall was a different story, though, because the street photos looked (noticeably / lively) than the portraits. In the end, the rooftop display drew far (many / visitor) than the organisers expected, and Fiona called it (third / exciting) show she has seen this year.
explanation_ru: Noticeably и far усиливают сравнительные формы livelier и more visitors; порядковое числительное с длинным прилагательным даёт the third most exciting.

prompt: Our team switched to a new room-booking app after the office move. At first, nobody enjoyed typing extra details before each meeting. Even so, the app prevents double bookings (significantly / smoothly) than our old spreadsheet ever did. Although it loads (still / slowly) on older laptops, it has proved much (reliable) when all departments meet at once.
explanation_ru: Significantly и still усиливают сравнительные наречия more smoothly и more slowly, а после much прилагательное reliable принимает форму more reliable.

prompt: Three local writers have published short histories of the old harbour. The pocket edition is cheap, yet it leaves out most of the nineteenth century. The updated edition is by far (complete) of the three, even though its chapters read (rather / confusingly) because several dates are missing. Still, readers who want real stories find it (a great deal / rich) in detail than the original version.
explanation_ru: By far требует превосходной степени the most complete из трёх изданий; rather усиливает наречие more confusingly, а a great deal — прилагательное richer.

prompt: Ronan asked me which parcel service our online shop should use for winter orders. The cheapest option looked tempting until we read reviews about late boxes. The express plan is easily (expensive) of the three quotes, yet its drivers handle boxes (considerably / carefully) than the budget firms. Wouldn't our staff work (significantly / calmly) in December if fewer parcels went missing?
explanation_ru: После easily при выборе из трёх вариантов нужна превосходная степень the most expensive; наречия carefully и calmly усиливаются через considerably и significantly.

prompt: These new headphones sound ___ than my old pair.
explanation_ru: Для усиления сравнительной степени используется much, а не very и не more; вариант very better — частая ошибка калькирования с русского.

prompt: That grey coat is ___ one in the shop for rainy days.
explanation_ru: Усилитель by far сочетается с превосходной степенью с артиклем the (by far the best), а не с very и не со сравнительной степенью при выборе из всего магазина.

prompt: Inspectors checked the bridge and said the crack was ___ than residents had feared.
explanation_ru: Перед сравнительной степенью less serious ставится far; very и more с less не употребляются, а by far обычно усиливает превосходную степень.

prompt: Do you think Kavita's essay will still pass even though the conclusion is ___ the limit, since every other section is well argued?
explanation_ru: Для небольшого отклонения от нормы подходит slightly shorter than; типичные ошибки — very со сравнительной степенью, двойная форма more short и союз as вместо than.

prompt: The shop assistant was much more kinder than the manager.
answer: The shop assistant was much kinder than the manager.
accepted_answers: The shop assistant was much kinder than the manager.
explanation_ru: Слово more лишнее: короткое прилагательное kind уже стоит в сравнительной степени kinder, а для усиления достаточно much.

prompt: Could you give us more further advice before we wash these wool curtains?
answer: Could you give us further advice before we wash these wool curtains?
accepted_answers: Could you give us further advice before we wash these wool curtains?
Could you give us any further advice before we wash these wool curtains?
Could you give us some further advice before we wash these wool curtains?
explanation_ru: Further уже является сравнительной формой («дополнительный»), поэтому добавлять перед ним more — типичная ошибка двойного сравнения.

prompt: For safety reasons, the new station ramp must be no narrower than the old concrete path.
answer: For safety reasons, the new station ramp must be no narrower than the old concrete path.
accepted_answers: For safety reasons, the new station ramp must be no narrower than the old concrete path.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкция no narrower than грамматически верна и точно передаёт требование «не уже прежней дорожки».

prompt: Among the four shift plans we discussed, closing early on Sundays was by far the better choice for the night staff.
answer: Among the four shift plans we discussed, closing early on Sundays was by far the best choice for the night staff.
accepted_answers: Among the four shift plans we discussed, closing early on Sundays was by far the best choice for the night staff.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о выборе из четырёх вариантов (among the four), поэтому после by far нужна превосходная степень the best, а не the better.

prompt: Tariq compared the winter coat in the corner shop with the exact same one online. Both have the same price tag, so he didn't save a single penny.
options: The online coat is no cheaper than the one in the corner shop.
The online coat is slightly cheaper than the one in the corner shop.
The online coat is much more expensive than the one in the corner shop.
The online coat is by far the cheapest in town.
explanation_ru: Выражение no cheaper than означает, что цена такая же (или выше), то есть экономии нет; остальные варианты искажают смысл ситуации.

prompt: The neighbourhood committee wants to book a new hall for the autumn concert. Only one venue in town holds more people, and tickets must cost the same as last year or less.
options: They want a hall that is easily the largest in town with tickets slightly more expensive than last year.
They want the second-largest hall in town with tickets no more expensive than last year.
They want the second-largest hall in town with tickets far more expensive than last year.
They want a hall that is much smaller than the old one with tickets a bit cheaper than last year.
explanation_ru: Если больше вмещает только один зал, нужный зал — the second-largest; условие «не дороже, чем в прошлом году» точно передаёт no more expensive than.

prompt: That wooden shelf cannot be thicker than the metal bracket. → That wooden shelf must be no …
answer: That wooden shelf must be no thicker than the metal bracket.
accepted_answers: That wooden shelf must be no thicker than the metal bracket.
explanation_ru: Запрет на превышение размера перефразируется конструкцией must be no + сравнительная степень + than.
